wu: Students play 'Memory Chain' with Earth Day vocabulary: I say 'recycle', student 1 says 'recycle, reuse', student 2 says 'recycle, reuse, reduce', and so on. Use flashcards for prompts.
wuAlt: Students brainstorm Earth Day words on the board in pairs, then share with the class.
Students match picture flashcards (e.g., bottle, tree, bin) to word cards on the table.
pres: Show a short video clip about Earth Day actions. Elicit sentences like 'I can recycle bottles' and 'We should save water'. Use a poster with key phrases: 'I can...', 'We should...', 'I will...'. Check understanding by asking 'What can you do?'
presAlt: Use a story about a Moroccan family planting trees on Green March Day to elicit past simple and future forms.
Model a roleplay between a shopkeeper and customer using 'paper or plastic?' to introduce environmental choices.
prac: Students play 'Error Auction': listen to sentences like 'I can to recycle' and bid on correct/incorrect ones. In pairs, they then correct the sentences on a worksheet.
pracAlt: Students complete a 'Find Someone Who...' grid with questions like 'Find someone who turns off lights'.
Play 'Green Bingo' with prompts like 'has a reusable bag'.
ls: Students listen to a short audio clip of a radio interview about Earth Day and tick the actions mentioned (e.g., 'plant trees', 'use less water').
re: After the break, play 'Green Charades': students act out actions like 'recycling' or 'watering plants' for their team to guess.
prod: In teams, students complete a 'Team Challenge' poster: draw a local problem (e.g., plastic in streets) and write three solutions using 'We can...'. Present to the class.
rw: Students read a short email from a friend asking about green habits and reply using 'I will...' sentences. Focus on correct punctuation and simple past forms for habits.
st: Read a short story about a Moroccan student who starts a recycling club at their school. End with: 'Today we reviewed how to talk about actions for Earth Day. Thank you, class.'
g: Listen to sentences, bid if correct/incorrect, then fix errors.
Add an Earth word each turn: recycle, reuse, reduce...
Ask classmates about green habits using 'Do you...?'
Act out eco-actions for teams to guess.
Draw a local problem and write three solutions on a poster.
diff: Fast finishers write a short paragraph: 'My family and Earth Day'.
Support learners use sentence starters: 'I can...', 'We should...' on a worksheet.
hw: Complete the pre-assessment checklist for the course.
Write one paragraph: 'One green habit I will start' using 'I will...'.
Watch a 2-minute video about Earth Day and list three new words.
tip: Connect local context by discussing Morocco's Green Generation Initiative and how small actions align with Islamic values of stewardship (khalifa).
